summary: Tested Brent Crude live update fix in Market Intelligence panel. Backend: 22/22 tests pass. API returns brent=$91.96 (non-zero, valid range), brent_chg_pct=-8.67% (history-based, no $0 or fake default), brent_chg_week=+4.48%, brent_chg_month=+24.83%. Frontend: Panel opens correctly, Brent shows $91.96 (not $0.00/em-dash), D timeframe shows -8.67% (Day), W timeframe switches to +4.39% (Week). VIX/Nifty/GIFT Nifty/PCR all loading correctly. Auto-refresh interval (2min) is set up in useEffect.

minor.issue: brent_chg_pct=-8.67% is a large daily change for Brent crude. May be a real market move or a history-based gap at futures contract rollover. Within ±30% sanity range, not a blocker. History approach (3mo period) is better than fast_info.previous_close which was returning $0.

critical_code_review_comments: brent_chg_pct shows -8.67% daily change — unusually large for Brent crude on a normal day. Could be legitimate or a futures contract rollover gap in yfinance BZ=F history data. Low priority since it's far better than the previous $0.00 issue. If this persists, consider using a 5-day rolling average for day change instead of just closes[-1] vs closes[-2].
M timeframe pill click failed in Playwright due to stale element reference (test script issue, not a real UI bug — W pill worked fine).
